Container.Name: Home-AI-QA-Tools
Container.Overview: Restricted live-read-only Tools service for Home-AI acceptance testing. Mutation permissions are enforced by the application mode and absent production credentials.

Config.Name: Host Port
Config.Description: Optional LAN port; keep unexposed unless required by the QA runner.

Config.Name: QA mode
Config.Description: Server-enforced read-only scope. Any other value is rejected by the image.

Config.Name: Tools service token
Config.Description: Private QA Assistant-to-Tools credential; never expose to Open WebUI or models.

Config.Name: QA Tools secret
Config.Description: Dedicated QA-only service token. Do not point at the production token.

Config.Name: QA state
Config.Description: Separate QA workflow and audit state; never share production state.
